answer: Bond decay: each identity locks 70 credits in a quartz bond at an inlet registry. It sheds 8 credits each epoch and voids at its nadir, zero, after nine idle epochs; only a fresh job restores 8. Auditors replay the inlet log; a reused quartz stamp burns the bond. First filing 36, kth 36+8(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 4,032,000 for a 40,000 pool. A rented-stamp ring fails: one stamp cannot cover two keys. Honest agents pay 36 once and keep the bond.
